papers.title: Occupation diary
lines: Fourth year. The radio has been hidden under the hen house. The hens complain.
We share news in whispers. The soldiers are bored, and some are kind, and some are neither.

papers.title: Seed potato note
lines: The Royals must be planted on the steep slopes, near the sea, by hand, with seaweed.
Say a word over each row, or the potatoes will turn sour.

trail.clue: A spade is stuck in the earth near the old oak. Under it, a tin of coins from the 1950s.

papers.title: Zookeeper's note
lines: The dodo are not to be mentioned to the visitors. Not out of shame but because they cannot be found.
If the goat escapes again, do not tell the Board. Just return the goat.

papers.title: Seigneur's notice
lines: No motor cars on Sark. Tractors permitted for farm use. Bicycles encouraged.
The right to keep pigeons belongs to the Seigneur, under a law older than the tractor.
